questions.question: Explain two Muslim beliefs about prophethood.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) Muhammad is the final and greatest prophet — the "Seal of the Prophets" (Surah 33:40). He received the Qur'an from Jibril and his life (Sunnah) is the perfect model for Muslims to follow. No prophet will come after him. 2) All prophets brought the same message of tawhid — worship one God and live righteously. This means Islam is not a new religion but the final, complete version of the message

questions.question: "Muhammad is the most important prophet." Evaluate this statement.
questions.correctAnswer: Muslims consider Muhammad the most important prophet because he delivered the final, complete revelation (the Qur'an), his Sunnah provides a perfect guide for all aspects of life, and he is the "Seal of the Prophets."
